doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: The Dick Cavett Show band and Bert's film footage
summary: Playing the Cavett show with Bob Rosengarden and filming with a Bolex.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Wow. I see you played with Bob Rosengarden on Dick Cavett?
Oh yeah. “The Dick Cavett Show.” That was a great show. It wasn’t like Johnny Carson it was more, well I learned a lot. They had people like Costeau and you know, all these people on it.
It was great. I mean you’d learn a lot.
So you got to sit there and listen to what the —

Not only did I sit there but I had a Bolex movie camera. And I asked Rosengarden when we started I said, “do you mind if I photograph?” He said, “if you’re not playing, do what you want.” So I’m sitting and I could see the stage and the stage is well lit, and I had a zoom. You know a Bolex was a great camera. I had a zoom I would zoom in and take all these photos of what was going on. So I got rehearsals, I got a lot of the in-person stuff.
I’ve still got it but there’s no sound. It’s not like a video. There’s no sound.

But I showed him the list one time. I showed Cavett the list. And he said, “well how am I going to have time to look at all that?” Because I’ve got I don’t know how many feet. But now you can’t get film and I can’t get a projector to play them. My projector broke so I borrowed a projector and put it on video. But there was a lot of material there. I don’t know. But you know what was funny was like Zero Mostel. He’d come up to the band and be doing all kinds of things and you could tell what he was saying by just looking at him. You didn’t have to hear it. I mean he was like, oh man, he just projected. He was great.
And you’d back up the musical guests too.

Yeah. Well I have Mary Lou Williams, I have Erroll Garner, I have the Modern Jazz Quartet, I have Mingus and Miles and whoever was on you know. A lot of people were on. Duke was on. But there’s no sound.
